entities.name: 5GS Session Management
entities.description: Procedures used for 5GS session management performed over an N1 NAS signalling connection. Main function is to support PDU session handling in the UE and SMF.

entities.name: PDU Session
entities.description: Represents a PDU session established between the UE and an SMF. Can remain established even if radio and network resources are temporarily released.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: Terminal equipment that establishes and maintains PDU sessions with the SMF.

entities.name: Session Management Function
entities.description: Network function responsible for session management, handling PDU sessions transferred via the AMF.

entities.name: Access and Mobility Management Function
entities.description: Network function that transfers 5GSM signaling between UE and SMF.

entities.name: N1 NAS Signalling Connection
entities.description: NAS signalling connection over which 5GSM procedures are performed.
